text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: How about it, Spe? There's no harm in giving it a try, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: W-wowie! You made this supplement all yourself, Tachyon?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And it's full of nutrients for smooth, radiant skin and glossy hair! I wonder what other benefits it'll have!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That's right! How about it, then? With this special offer made just for you… you can have it for free!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Agnes Tachyon is using some shady sales talk on Special Week…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Free?! A-are you sure?! Thanks so much, Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, yes. Go ahead, now.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You… really shouldn't do that.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, hello there, Cafe… and Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …You have no idea… what could happen. Your hair… could start growing. Or, you could start glowing.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Glowing?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Glowing! Now isn't that something! That wouldn't be a hindrance to your daily life in the slightest!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Besides, you taking this is for the advancement of Umamusume-kind. A worthy sacrifice!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Just where would we be if it weren't for past sacrifices, hm?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Worthy? For who? You'd be the only one to… get something out of it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, um… sorry! On second thought, I think I'll pass!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Agh, my precious Umamusume test subject…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Well… I should leave… too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Whoa whoa! Hold on, Cafe!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …What is it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: My losing Spe is due to your meddling. Have some accountability for your actions and take my supplement in her place!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I always… ask myself this… but have you ever considered… testing it on yourself?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Of course I'd take it! But, it's practically useless obtaining results from only myself!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Even two or three participants wouldn't be an ample sample size!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I won't… do it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! How could you say that?! Come ooon, Cafe! Help me out!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: To achieve accurate results, it's necessary to examine every Umamusume under various conditions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon seems to be just one "no" away from throwing a full tantrum. What to do…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Huh? …You?! But you're not an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …You shouldn't be so picky when… it comes to people offering help.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I know… Trainer has always been very proactive when it comes to these things.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmph! You should learn a thing or two from Trainer's enthusiasm, Cafe!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You… must have a lot on your plate…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe looks at me sympathetically as I head to the laboratory with Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Please! Cafe…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …I already told you no.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hrngh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe takes a pill out of Agnes Tachyon's pocket and forces it into Tachyon's mouth.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Argh… It's… so bright…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh… This is quite a valuable experience, but… it's so bright I can't see anything! My eyes hurt!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon continues to glow for three days and three nights…
